text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After stocking up on training goods with
Inari
One at the shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Good. Looks like we crossed off
everything on
our list at that last shop!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! Most of it's for me,
so it'd
be rude
if I didn't come.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's a raffle! They do 'em 'round
these parts
too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I did my share back in my hometown but
never
really had any luck. Still, somethin'
always keeps me comin' back to try
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I remember receiving a raffle
ticket
from our last purchase.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wait just a sec! That came from your shoppin'. It's only right that you use it.
choice_data_list: Since I've got it, I'll give this ...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wait just a sec! That came from your shoppin'. It's only right that you use it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The items I bought are for Inari One to
use. In
other words, this ticket belongs
to the both of us.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I like the sound of that. Makes me
wanna
crank that lever even more!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, this is our big chance! Let's spin it together and reel in somethin' huge!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oh, you two are going to try together?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yes, count the both of us in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the challenge, we spin it
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize winner! Come and get the
ticket for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: W-we got... the grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, yeeees! Our little ol' raffle
ticket turned
into a grand prize! I didn't
actually think we'd nail
it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I guess pullin' it together
combined both
our lucks!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a hot spring getaway... I can't
believe it!
Hot springs are my go-to
when I think of
vacations!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Delicious food, big baths—talk about
vacationin'
in style! Hehe, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Except... we gotta focus on the now.
Either way, it
looks like this ticket won't
expire for a while.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So could ya hold onto it for the time
being?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sure as ever! I needa focus on holdin' my ground in those central races. 'Sides, if our trip is a victory celebration, then I can really relax!
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but... are you sure?
I don't mind, but... are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not a bad idea to save the goods for
later, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right? Now that we've got somethin' fun
to look
forward to, let's keep at it!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeeees! We did it, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeeees! We did it, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this is a nice first prize! You don't
see
somethin' this fancy every day!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A meal this good deserves to be eaten
quick!
Let's get right to it once we're
back at your office!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we indulge in the delicious
deluxe
carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! We got somethin' good!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's one generous prize! Just look at
this giant
heap!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Ya know what this calls for—a
carrot
festival! Maybe we could get
Creek to give us a
hand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You gotta come too! C'mon, there's no
time
better than now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I enjoy the carrot festival
with Inari
One and her friends!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, well, at least we got somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this carrot looks pretty good. Bet
it tastes
great just on its own!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's split it once we get back. Hey, how
do ya
like your carrots anyways?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I eat my share of the carrot
with Inari
One!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guuugh! We pulled a dud!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss! That was our chance to
strike gold,
and I blew it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss! That was our chance to
strike gold,
and I blew it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess... But I wanted to win with
style, not
cramp it! Ugh, it's actually
friggin' frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After pulling a blank, Inari One's mood
takes a
sharp nosedive...
